Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) See section 171 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(ii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions
(iii) For the offence wording relating to goods other than weapons and ammunition see H3634.
(iv) This offence was inserted by section 293(2) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine of the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods, whichever is the greater.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
